text: The mozAddonManager policy fixture catches rejected createInstall/install attempts and then dispatches mozAddonManagerDone. The event means the attempt has settled after success or rejection; it is not an installed-addon assertion. The blocked and allowed policy tests register the event listener before clicking, separately wait for the expected notification, dismiss it, await settlement, and close the tab. Their HTTPS example.com test access, certificate and user-activation preferences are harness setup. The separate unsigned test waits for onInstallCancelled and explicitly asserts the addon is absent. The owned comm change replaces InstallTrigger test calls and deletes its already disabled test, while upstream implementation removal stays outside this source scope. No tests or installs were run.
title: The policy install fixture Done event means settlement, not installation
